issue.title: Window menu doesn't work on OSX
issue.body: The "Window" menu in the menu bar normally contains the options "Minimize", "Zoom" and "Enter Full Screen", as well as a list of windows. In an SFML program, though these menu items exist, they are greyed out, which also has the unfortunate side-effect that the familiar keyboard shortcuts for these actions don't work either.
